title: Edit Distance
summary: Count the fewest single-letter inserts, deletes and replacements that turn one word into another.

tests.explain: Replace the t with a c.
Delete the f (law), then insert an n at the end (lawn).
Starting from nothing, insert all three letters.

hints: Look at the last letters of both words. If they are equal, they need no edit at all.
If they differ, the last edit was a replace, a delete or an insert. Each one leaves a smaller pair of prefixes to fix.
dp[i][j] = fewest edits for the first i letters of word1 and the first j of word2. dp[i][0] = i, dp[0][j] = j; on a mismatch dp[i][j] = 1 + min(diagonal, above, left).

complexity.time: O(m × n): one cell per pair of prefixes
complexity.space: O(m × n) for the table (O(min(m, n)) with two rows)
